headword: {顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}
gloss: deathly pale; white as a sheet

definitions.gloss: deathly pale; white as a sheet
definitions.explanation: A state where one's face has lost all color, typically from shock, fear, illness, or extreme emotion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}になった。
⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧{顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}だった。
examples.english: She was white as a sheet after hearing the news.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、{顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Some students turned pale upon seeing their exam results.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目撃|もくげき}した→目撃する：20232_mokugekisuru⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、みな{顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{立|た}ちすくんでいた→立ちすくむ：18704_tachisukumu⟧。
examples.english: Everyone who witnessed the accident scene stood frozen, white as a sheet.

notes:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧): ⟦{顔面|がんめん}→顔面：14693_ganmen⟧ (face) + ⟦{蒼白|そうはく}→蒼白：14054_souhaku⟧ (pale, pallid). Describes the dramatic loss of color from the face.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: turn deathly pale
- {顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}で⟦{立|た}ちすくむ→立ちすくむ：18704_tachisukumu⟧: stand frozen, pale-faced
- {顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧: a pale-faced patient

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{青|あお}ざめる→青ざめる：14612_aozameru⟧: to turn pale — a verb form; more commonly used in everyday speech
- {血|ち}の{気|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: the blood drains from one's face — a vivid idiomatic expression for turning pale
- ⟦{真|ま}っ{青|さお}→真っ青：07615_massao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to turn completely pale/blue — casual and common

USAGE:
More dramatic and literary than ⟦{青|あお}ざめる→青ざめる：14612_aozameru⟧. Commonly appears in novels, news reports about emergencies, and dramatic descriptions. Can be used as a na-adjective ({顔面蒼白|がんめんそうはく}な⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧) or as a noun with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧.
